notes.title: ORPHEUS Early Access 1.02 - Big Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it been longtime i won t make any news but i m working hard on ORPHEUS and big update is finally here. It is update who add more game feels and improve menu of the game. I will list you all changes (so main things i remember, i don t know if i will think about little details :D ) :

- finish title menu and completely change it 

- add difficulty mode, player have choice between 3 difficulty mod (Assist Mod, Normal and God Mod) i don t think it will give you special rewards in future, i m just see a lot of personn tested my game and i want a game who can adapt to any types of players, so it give you benefits or remove you somes functionnality

- started to implement differents vfx for somes actions for add more game feel, it not finished 

- improve somes patterns of boss 

- improve somes 2D asset and UI

- improve 2d artwork of characters

- fixing multiples bugs like bug who make player slide on wall

- added animations for ennemies and player and replace somes sprites

- And finally added ambient lightning on all differents levels

SO THANKS YOU FOR READ THIS POST AND I HOPE YOU WILL PLAY MY GAME. THANKS YOU A LOT FOR FOLLOW ME IN THIS ADVENTURE :)

For people who already install the game, if you have somes problems with the game, désinstall and réinstall the game (your save will be preserved)

notes.title: About Future Update
notes.content:
Hi it been 2 weeks, the early access is officially released, a lot of people i know test the game. I prepare a big update who fixing and add somes changes. 

Before explainining i i make a new video where i show the evolution of my game since 2021 
[previewyoutube=SsalUwoOy3U;full][/previewyoutube]

For future update, i see a lot of bugs like sliding in somes walls, music who stop, somes physics bugs so i will try to fix them. I m planned to fixed balancing of game, i think level 1 is too hard for beginners, i will arrange that. I need to arrange somes boss patterns, i try to add more animated ennemies and make script for make breathing, ennemies who are just an image sprite. I will start to work on 3 difficulty mod, there will not affect patterns and ennemies, it will affect player : 

- [b]normal mod[/b] : default mode, player has 6 lives and no bonus, demeter tree for save and load are still accessible 
- [b]assist mod[/b] : a mod for beginner players, in this mod player has 15 lives and your projectiles scale and damage limits are increased, projectiles will stay longer 
- [b]god mod[/b] : the players has choice of 2 options : 1 lives or no demeter tree for save and load, the player can also activate the two option at the same time

this mod are not really necessarly, it just for add challenge and inclusion, adapt to all type of players

THANKS YOU A LOT FOR READING THIS ARTICLE AND FOR SUPPORT MY GAME
